retainedInvariants: Anti-self-warrant: a derived-only type is never authored and no record is evidence for itself.
The authority digest is a pure function of graph content; no environment statistic may enter it.
Exactly one implementation decides any given semantic question.
Absence is never permission: a consequential state declares its basis and fails closed.
An empty result is never ambiguous between evaluated-and-clean and not-evaluated.
Scope, authorization and conclusion are three separate facts.
Exact identity or none; ambiguity is a rejection, never a silent first pick.
A superseded resource is never referenced as current.
One authoritative declaration of where each artefact belongs and what it is called.
Authority impact derives from semantic closure, not physical file membership.
The authority used to select an execution must still be current when that execution begins.
Work that depends on other work is not executable until its dependencies are satisfied.
Secrets are confined to exactly one artefact class and never digested into a record.
